These changes aim to improve classless mechanics for this tier set while still providing essential power boosts for obtaining the 5 set.

Reworked the Avenger Set Bonus (AQT 2.5) 5 Set: 

Your damaging melee abilities have a chance to deal an additional 30% of your spell power as Holy damage.

Reworked the Avenger Set Bonus (AQT 2.5) 3 Set: 

Your melee critical strike rating is increased by 12% of your Intellect and your spell critical strike rating is increased by 8% of your Strength.

5.description:
Genesis 5 Set has been reworked because the Tier stats have been reworked from the ground up.

When you bring a target to full health with a periodic heal (this includes proc effects like Sheath of Light or Earthliving) you have a chance to increase your Spirit by 10% and your healing power by 20% of your Spirit for 10 seconds. This effect can only occur every 20 seconds.

6.description: [Temple of AhnQiraj] [Cthun] Added a Heroic Version of the Eye of Cthun and its quest.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Cthun] Giant Claw Tentacle are now immune against all forms of crowd control.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Cthun] Cthun will now summon his Tentacle 1 second faster for each Weakening Phase he survived.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Cthun] Cthun will now immediately remove Weakening from himself if he takes more then 40% of his total health in damage during a single weakening phase.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Cthun] Corrected an issue where C'thun could fail to summon a second Giant Claw Tentacle and Giant Eye Tentacle on Ascended 25 Player difficulty.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Ouro] Corrected an issue where Mind Corrupting Shard were treated as having a much higher level then intended, causing them to have a much higher armor value then intended.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Ouro] Mind Corrupting Shards are now immune against all forms of crowd control.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Ouro] Sanstorms now apply Ouros Fury to enemies within 10 yards up from 3.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Ouro] Changed the movement logic Sandstorms during submerged phase. Sandstorms should no longer move trough walls or become stuck in the ground.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Ouro] Ouro will now submerge 45 seconds after each emerge. Previously he would start a timer while being submerged, causing him to submerge more often then intended.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Ouro] Corrected an issue where the dungeon could become stuck with the encounter being in progress, not allowing player to re-enter, accept resurrection or use checkpoints.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Ouro] Ouro has been rewritten.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Twin Emperors] Increased the amount of threat added to the closest player after the Twin Emperors used teleport by 1000%.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Twin Emperors] The Twin Emperors will now heal each other for a percentage amount of their health rather then a fixed value.

[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Twin Emperors] Corrected an issue where the dungeon could become stuck with the encounter being in progress, not allowing player to re-enter, accept resurrection or use checkpoints.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Twin Emperors] Corrected an issue where the Twin Emperors would fail to respawn Bugs or Scorpions once they were used.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Twin Emperors] Corrected an issue where the Twin Emperors would fail to find a Bug or Scorpion to explode or mutate.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Twin Emperors] Corrected an issue where Emperor Veklor could not use his other abilities until being interrupted.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Twin Emperors] Corrected an issue where the Twin Emperors would delay events after their teleport by such a large margin they would never execute them.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Twin Emperors] Corrected an issue where the Twin Emperors would stop using abilities.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Twin Emperors] The Twin Emperors have been rewritten.

[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Princes Huhuran] Vekniss Martyr no longer spawn from the roof of Huhurans room. They now spawn from the Honeycombs around the room. This extends their travel time and reduces the angle from where they fly down to make it easier to spot them and eventually kill them before they can explode.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Viscidus] Viscidus now deals Nature damage instead of physical damage with his melee attacks.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Fankriss the Unyielding] Spawn of Fankriss are now immune against most forms of crowd control.

[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Royal Bug Family] Corrected an issue where the dungeon could become stuck with the encounter being in progress, not allowing player to re-enter, accept resurrection or use checkpoints.
[Temple of AhnQiraj] [Royal Bug Family] Corrected multiple issues where it was possible to pull single members of the Royal Bug Family without pulling it allies.
